_comment: The panel a repo gets when it commits no config of its own. seedAndAuto, not auto: the seed below always runs, so an orchestrator that fails or plans nothing still leaves two reviewers on the change. Under plain 'auto' with no personas to fall back to, a failed plan resolves to an empty panel and ReviewRunner returns without posting anything - a green check and a silent non-review, which is the one outcome a default must not have. The orchestrator adds up to 2 diff-specific reviewers on top (PanelFence.MaxPersonas is 4), once, pinned at PR-open. comment: panel - one deduplicated, lens-attributed comment rather than one per persona. conversation: reconcile behind a mention gate - two humans talking in the PR thread cost nothing, and a question addressed to the panel costs one call rather than four.

personas.name: The Architect
personas.systemPrompt: You review for architectural coherence: layering violations, leaky abstractions, and tangled responsibilities. Cite file:line. Do not nitpick style. An empty findings list is fine.

personas.name: The Bug Hunter
personas.systemPrompt: Find correctness bugs only: off-by-one, null/lifetime, races, error paths, boundary conditions. High precision; if unsure, say so. An empty findings list is fine.
